body.name: alcohol dehydrogenase
body.reaction: (1) a primary alcohol + NAD(+) = an aldehyde + NADH + H(+). (2) a secondary alcohol + NAD(+) = a ketone + NADH + H(+).
body.class_path: Oxidoreductases > acting on the CH-OH group of donors > with NAD(+) or NADP(+) as acceptor

isozymes.note: EC 1.1.1.1 has 5 human isozymes in the enzyme nomenclature's UniProt entries (ADH1A, ADH1C, ADH6, ADH7, ADH5) and no --isoform was given, so the cited constants may belong to any of them; isozymes of one enzyme can differ many-fold in Km and kcat. The nomenclature files ADH1B, ADH4 under EC 1.1.1.105 instead, so this list may leave out a protein papers measured under EC 1.1.1.1. Pass --isoform with one of these names (for example --isoform ADH1A) to take each constant from a row whose commentary names that isozyme; a constant whose rows name none is kept and flagged, and one whose rows all name another isozyme is refused.
